To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the knowledge management system of a SME consists of a balanced set of methods and supporting software, and that the methods and software tools are harmonised with the key knowledge processes.
(1) the use of knowledge management (KM) tools in SMEs is low, (2) the use of tools is not related to firm size, and (3) the use of KM tools is not related with the use of KM methods.
the knowledge management system in SMEs is characterized by a balanced system for knowledge process support.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a balanced system for knowledge process in SMEs, which is based on the results of an empirical study.
the development and implementation of a balanced system for knowledge process support in SMEs.

the development of a knowledge management system in SMEs, which can be used as a basis for the design of knowledge management applications and the development of knowledge management software for SMEs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the knowledge management system for SMEs should be based on a “TechnicalSocialSocial Technical Model” (TSSTM).Practical implications – The paper describes a model for knowledge management in SME.
the knowledge management methods in SMEs have to be balanced in order to support all knowledge processes.
knowledge management in SME is an interdisciplinary field of study and practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

knowledge management is a very important issue for the future development of the company, and it is a challenge for the managers of SMEs to find a suitable way to implement it in their companies, and to find the right balance between technical and social methods and tools.
the TSST Model is a balanced system to describe knowledge management in SME's.
the TSST Model can serve as a basis for a balanced knowledge process management system in SMEs.

the knowledge management systems in small and medium-sized companies are characterized by a balanced system of technical and social knowledge management.
the use of social media for knowledge management is not just a matter of technology, but also a matter of organizational culture, leadership and management.
